step2_implementation.whatWasAdded: Tier1RecordRetirement + isEarnedRecordRetirement + buildRecordRetirement in the lib file -- the SAME family as Tier1LeafAbsence/isEarnedLeafAbsence (CTX-LEAVES) one level up, at the record rather than the leaf. ConformantTier1Payload gains a required recordRetirement: Tier1RecordRetirement | null field, ALWAYS present (never an omitted key). buildConformantTier1Payload computes it from ONLY the already-fetched cadPropertyRoll (the declared-vintage cad_property read the bake already does for the dollar facets, ALL rows, not filtered to a use code): apn present, roll consulted, and byPropId has no row for it -> retired. Any prop_id present in the current roll structurally cannot reach this branch. recordRetirement is added to DIVERGENCE_IGNORE_NEW_SHAPE_KEYS (new-shape-only, same treatment as shapeSource/baked/source/access/publishRunId) so the old-vs-new divergence instrument is unaffected.
step2_implementation.cliChange: The CLI computes rollAbsent = cadPropertyRoll.consulted && !cadPropertyRoll.byPropId.has(propId) BEFORE the situs read. A rollAbsent record takes situsForRetiredBake (new, exported-locally) -- the claim's raw situsAddress, trimmed, with NO punctuation-only guard -- instead of situsForBake, so a retirement declaration is never gated by the very data-quality symptom (a punctuation-only situs on stale claim content, the mechanism CP1 established) that today causes these accounts to be silently skipped. A live record's situs handling is completely unchanged (same function, same refusal, same skippedBadSitus counter). The write path, assertNoOwnerKey / assertLandUseAbsenceEarned / assertRequiredLeafStatesEarned, and the place_layer_snapshots upsert are unchanged -- retired records now simply REACH the write instead of being skipped. Summary JSON gains a `retired` count alongside `written`.
